title: Red Action Wings Foundation hands out appointment letters and identity cards
description: Under the Nadia district of West Bengal, new members were given appointment letters and identity cards under the supervision of Red Action Wings Foundation.
content: Under the Nadia district of West Bengal, new members were given appointment letters and identity cards under the supervision of Red Action Wings Foundation. They were also felicitated with flowers. The programme was completed with the cooperation of Falguni Dutta and Ashish Chunari, CIOs of the West Bengal RAW Foundation. Miss Dutta said that it was her good fortune to be present among them today. Miss Dutta said that they should work with dedication and not cross their limits. Before doing any work, they should definitely take advice from their superior, and not take any step without instructions. Jai Hind. Seeing this programme, Manoj Chauhan, the director of this organisation, extended his congratulations.
author: Rajkumar Prasad – Sahara Jeevan News

title: District Programme Officer reaches to probe shortfall in dry rations, reprimands officials
description: Action taken on complaint by team formed by Red Action Wing organisation
content:
Chhanbe, Mirzapur. A case of shortfall in the dry rations given to Anganwadi workers from the warehouse of the Child Development Project Office in Vijaypur development block came to light. On the complaint of the Red Action Wing organisation, the DPO reprimanded Child Development Project Officer Indulata Pathak and directed her to investigate and take action.

On Saturday, women of a group complained and objected to the shortfall in the dry rations supplied from the Child Development Project Office at Gaipura to beneficiaries through Anganwadi centres. Officials of the Red Action Wing organisation went there and asked the warehouse in-charge why less ration was being given, but he stayed silent. This was reported to the District Magistrate’s CUG number.

District Programme Officer Vani Verma arrived at the spot. In her inspection she found that the dry ration of Hargarh Anganwadi Centres 1 and 2 was short by 34 packets of chana dal and 34 packets of dalia, in addition to seven packets of refined oil. She reprimanded CDPO Indulata Pathak. When the Block Coordinator, Rahul Kumar, who was distributing the dry foodgrain from the warehouse, was asked about it, he said the full foodgrain had been given and some might have spilled somewhere.

A four-member team of the Red Action Wing organisation was present at the spot. Women of the Mishrapur, Vijaypur, Dugauli, Parwa, Adampur and Hargarh groups said that they are given less dry ration every time, while slips are signed for a larger quantity of foodgrain. The women office-bearers of the group alleged that dry ration has never been distributed in some Anganwadi centres.

The District Programme Officer assured that she would identify such Anganwadi centres, carry out surprise inspections and take action. She also directed action on complaints that came to light from villages of the area, including Kasdhana, Naroia, Kolahi, Dugauli, Manikathi, Mishrapur, Gonaura, Jigna, Baunta, Visheshar Singh, Negura and Ban Singh Gaura. All Anganwadi workers were instructed that on the next working day, dry ration would be distributed at the village school in the presence of the Gram Pradhan and management committee members.
author: RAWF National Command

title: One accused arrested with ganja
description: Ladyari, Prayagraj. Under the leadership of Station House Officer Ashish Singh, Khiri police on Wednesday arrested Yasmini, wife of Amarkant, a resident of village Gobra..
content: Ladyari, Prayagraj. Under the leadership of Station House Officer Ashish Singh, Khiri police on Wednesday arrested Yasmini, wife of Amarkant, a resident of village Gobra, Khiri police station, Prayagraj district, from Gobra village with 340 grams of illegal ganja. A case was registered under the NDPS Act and further legal action was taken. The arresting team included Sub-Inspector Ashok Kumar Singh, Girish Chandra Rai, and Women Sub-Inspector (Trainee) Priyanka Rawat, among others.
author: Swatantra Prayag

title: Joint raid by Red Action Wing and police team recovers 500 grams of ganja
description: Prayagraj. Upon receiving information about ganja smuggling in the Khiri police station area of the district, the Red Action Wing and police carried out a joint raid at two places in the Khiri police station area on Wednesday. During the raid, 500 grams of ganja was recovered.
content: Prayagraj. Upon receiving information about ganja smuggling in the Khiri police station area of the district, the Red Action Wing and police carried out a joint raid at two places in the Khiri police station area on Wednesday. During the raid, 500 grams of ganja was recovered. Red Action Wing director Sujeet Singh and Commissioner Manoj Chauhan, along with the Prayagraj and Mirzapur teams, were present during the raid. A woman was caught red-handed selling ganja, and 500 grams was recovered during her body search. The Khiri police station police provided commendable cooperation in the raid. In this series, the Red Action Wing is always working with the cooperation of the public and police. Under the orders of Red Action Wing director Sujeet Singh and the directions of Commissioner Manoj Chauhan of RAW, the ganja smuggling raid in the Khiri police station area of Prayagraj district on 8 May 2024 was successfully carried out by the police team.
author: Nalini Singh – Prayag Bharat
